verses.pali: “Pañcime, bhikkhave, āghātapaṭivinayā yattha bhikkhuno uppanno āghāto sabbaso paṭivinetabbo.
verses.english: “Mendicants, a mendicant should use these five ways to completely get rid of resentment when it has arisen toward anyone.

verses.pali: Yasmiṁ, bhikkhave, puggale āghāto jāyetha, mettā tasmiṁ puggale bhāvetabbā;
verses.english: You should develop love for an individual you resent.
That’s how to get rid of resentment for that individual.

verses.pali: Yasmiṁ, bhikkhave, puggale āghāto jāyetha, karuṇā tasmiṁ puggale bhāvetabbā;
verses.english: You should develop compassion for an individual you resent. …

verses.pali: Yasmiṁ, bhikkhave, puggale āghāto jāyetha, upekkhā tasmiṁ puggale bhāvetabbā;
verses.english: You should develop equanimity for an individual you resent. …

verses.pali: Yasmiṁ, bhikkhave, puggale āghāto jāyetha, asatiamanasikāro tasmiṁ puggale āpajjitabbo;
verses.english: You should disregard an individual you resent, paying no attention to them. …

verses.pali: Yasmiṁ, bhikkhave, puggale āghāto jāyetha, kammassakatā tasmiṁ puggale adhiṭṭhātabbā:
verses.english: You should focus on the ownership of deeds regarding that individual:
‘This venerable is the owner of their deeds and heir to their deeds. Deeds are their womb, their relative, and their refuge.

verses.pali: yaṁ kammaṁ karissati kalyāṇaṁ vā pāpakaṁ vā tassa dāyādo bhavissatī’ti;
verses.english: They shall be the heir of whatever deeds they do, whether good or bad.’
That’s how to get rid of resentment for that individual.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca āghātapaṭivinayā, yattha bhikkhuno uppanno āghāto sabbaso paṭivinetabbo”ti.
verses.english: A mendicant should use these five ways to completely get rid of resentment when it has arisen toward anyone.”
